long_biography.plain_text:
Philanthropy provides the clearest view of María Teresa Gual-Aspe beyond her investment activities. Gilberto A.C., a Mexican charity focused on housing and livelihoods for vulnerable families, listed her in 2024 as both a vice-president and its director of fundraising. Her giving has included paying for a replacement boiler at a care home in Aliseda, Spain.

Her financial profile is quieter. As a private investor, Gual-Aspe has appeared for years in a shareholder group with shared voting power over FEMSA shares; the group's arrangements continue to name her. She was married to businessman Alberto Baillères until his death in 2022. Their son Alejandro now holds operating control of the family group, while her own role remains that of investor and charity officer.
